metadata.title: fix(security): Enforce per-server oauth_enabled on MCP endpoints
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

- Enforce the per-server `oauth_enabled` flag on MCP transport endpoints, closing the gap where OAuth was advertised (via RFC 9728) but never enforced
- Unauthenticated requests to `oauth_enabled` servers now receive 401 regardless of the global `MCP_REQUIRE_AUTH` setting
- Defense-in-depth checks added to all six MCP handlers (`list_tools`, `call_tool`, `list_prompts`, `get_prompt`, `list_resources`, `read_resource`)
- Fix DAR202 lint warning in `set_log_level` docstring

Closes #3304

## Test plan

- [ ] Verify unauthenticated requests to `oauth_enabled=True` servers return 401 in permissive mode
- [ ] Verify unauthenticated requests to `oauth_enabled=False` servers still pass through in permissive mode
- [ ] Verify authenticated requests to `oauth_enabled=True` servers work normally
- [ ] Verify DB lookup failures in OAuth enforcement fail-open (preserve permissive mode)
- [ ] Verify all existing unit tests pass with no regressions (290 transport tests, 12,795 total unit tests)

commits.message:
fix(security): enforce per-server OAuth on MCP endpoints (Closes #3304)

When a virtual server has oauth_enabled=True, unauthenticated requests
to its MCP endpoints are now rejected with HTTP 401 and a
WWW-Authenticate header containing the RFC 9728 resource metadata URL,
even when MCP_REQUIRE_AUTH=false (permissive mode). This closes the gap
where OAuth was advertised via metadata but never enforced on requests.

Key changes:
- Add _check_server_oauth_enforcement() with per-request ContextVar
  caching and fail-closed behavior on DB errors (503)
- Add _build_resource_metadata_url() for RFC 9728 WWW-Authenticate
- Enforce at both middleware and handler levels (defense-in-depth)
- Refactor auth logic into _StreamableHttpAuthHandler class
- Extract loadTeamSelectorDropdown() from inline x-data to fix broken
  HTML attribute parsing with double-quote characters
- Add OAuthRequiredError and OAuthEnforcementUnavailableError classes
- Update docs: AGENTS.md, ADR-004, RFC 9728 compliance, security
  features, multitenancy, configuration reference

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer

commits.message:
fix(security): add catch-all for unexpected auth errors in _auth_jwt

- Add `except Exception` handler in `_StreamableHttpAuthHandler._auth_jwt`
  to catch unexpected errors (not HTTPException or SQLAlchemyError) during
  JWT authentication, returning 401 instead of an unhandled 500.
- Make OAuth enforcement comment in `set_logging_level` handler consistent
  with all other handlers (full 6-line rationale block).
- Add test for unexpected exception path in JWT auth.
- Black formatting fixes on test file.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
